title: Bid email to approved estimate
subtitle: n8n + Claude + GoHighLevel: plans in, draft estimate out, estimator approves

nodes.label:
GC emails plan set
+ spec PDFs

n8n workflow
detect email, pull PDFs

Claude reads plans/specs
returns JSON per field
+ confidence

Pricing rules applied in code
rates, waste, markup, minimums

Estimator approval
-> GHL sends to customer

Quantities from plan PDFs:
low confidence or missing
-> manual review

Unreadable PDF or
workflow error -> alert

notes.text: where these builds usually break: quantities pulled from plan PDFs. A confident wrong number is worse than a flagged gap.
